scope.method: Viewed canonical reference, overview contact sheet, and all 57 original 192x208 frames in ordered native-size horizontal composites. Read review.json and jump-placement.json.

identity_and_integrity.observed: Across the inspected rows, the compact approximately 2.5-head silhouette, long grey-green hair, purple eyes, blue earrings, asymmetric navy embroidered jacket, long black skirt, grey ankle socks and black shoes remain recognizable relative to canonical-base.png. Full heads, hair tips, skirt and shoes remain inside the cells; no conspicuous missing body region, accidental hole through the figure, detached limb or clipped extremity was visible at native size.
identity_and_integrity.metadata_evidence: review.json reports the expected count for all nine states, 192x208 cells and zero edge pixels for every frame.

rows.observed_evidence: Hands remain folded at the waist and feet stay planted. Eyes progress from open through half-lidded frame 02 to clearly closed frame 03, then reopen. Calm expression and stable outfit silhouette.

Right-facing profile, streaming hair, bent arms and alternating separated/under-body leg poses convey rightward running. Frames 02 and 05 lift a knee more strongly and expose the bent leg through the skirt opening; the leg, sock and shoe remain connected and the skirt reads as lifted fabric rather than broken anatomy. No major clothing failure visible.
minor_limitations: Higher-knee poses 02/05 make cadence less uniform than the leftward row; static inspection supports a minor cadence warning only.

rows.observed_evidence: Left-facing profile and trailing hair clearly distinguish the direction. Forward-extension and tucked-foot poses alternate; both feet and the long skirt remain readable. Opposite jacket panels show direction-appropriate differences instead of an obvious duplicated front view.
The hand rises from the waist toward the cheek, opens in frame 02 and returns in frame 03. The other arm stays near the waist and the feet remain planted; a small reserved wave is readable.

Hands are raised near the chest and both feet remain together. Ordered cells visibly rise to frame 02 and return symmetrically. jump-placement.json records foot lifts 0,4,8,4,0 px with whole-frame integer vertical translations; the silhouette stays inside safe margins. The 188px row height versus 198px elsewhere makes the pose modestly shorter, but side-by-side native-size review did not show a conspicuous scale pop.
minor_limitations: Cross-state transition timing was not played; the approximately 5% height difference is recorded rather than claimed absent.

rows.observed_evidence: Gaze lowers and eyes close as the head dips through frames 02-04, then the head and eyes recover through 05-07. Hands stay together and shoes remain planted, giving a downcast, restrained recovery.
Hands are held near the upper chest/chin, with alternating small head tilts in 01 and 03. Open eyes and the attentive pose read as expectant waiting; the lower body remains stable.

This task-active row stays planted: one hand rests near the chin, the other arm supports it across the torso. The focused expression and short eye closures in 01/03 support a thinking/working action without a traveling gait.

Hands remain folded low while the gaze and head tilt vary, including a clearer tilt in 03 and closed-eye smile in 04, then returning to the neutral pose in 05. The row reads as a reserved consideration/acknowledgment gesture, distinct from the hand-at-chin running row.

minor_limitations: This is an ordered static-frame inspection, not an animated playback or application-display test; smooth timing and loop perception remain to be verified during final preview.
Rightward frames 02/05 have more pronounced knee lift than the leftward cadence, without visible broken anatomy or clothing.
Jumping uses a 188px figure height versus 198px in other states; the small size difference is visible on comparison but not conspicuous at native display size.
Fine embroidery changes with pose and is represented at small raster size; the navy asymmetric costume identity remains readable.
decision: Pass for proceeding to cardinal-direction generation. This decision covers only the inspected preclean nine-state frames.
